perplexity.description:
Stax Does The Beatles is a 2008 compilation album featuring artists from the legendary Stax Records label interpreting songs by The Beatles. Released by Craft Recordings, the album showcases a fusion of Rock and Funk/Soul, as Stax’s signature Southern soul sound—marked by gritty horns, tight rhythm sections, and emotive vocals—reimagines Beatles classics. The result is a vibrant, groove-driven take on tracks originally rooted in British pop and rock, highlighting the versatility of both the Beatles’ songwriting and the Stax house style.

This album stands as a unique entry in the Stax discography, bridging two iconic musical worlds: the British Invasion and American soul. While Stax is best known for its own original hits and its role in shaping soul and R&B, Stax Does The Beatles demonstrates the label’s ability to reinterpret outside material with authenticity and flair. The album was first released digitally in 2008 and later issued on vinyl for Record Store Day in 2019, underscoring its cult appeal among collectors and fans of both The Beatles and Stax soul. Critical reception has been positive, with reviewers praising the inventive arrangements and the way the album honors both the spirit of the Beatles’ songs and the raw energy of Stax’s musical legacy.
